purpose: Compare the audited pre-change export path with the implemented local evidence lifecycle without implying an RF-result re-run.

comparisons.before: Exports were render-time outputs with no persisted ReportDefinition.
comparisons.after: A validated ReportDefinition records project, scenario, exact revision when available, source Run IDs, sections, presentation options, and source kind.

comparisons.before: Markdown and printable HTML were delivered through an ephemeral Blob/window path.
comparisons.after: GeneratedReportArtifact bytes are retained in a separate atom-artifacts IndexedDB bytes store and can be downloaded again offline.

comparisons.before: No durable byte size, storage reference, generator version, or availability state.
comparisons.after: Immutable metadata records artifact identity, lineage, format, byte size, local storage reference, schema/generator versions, provenance, warnings, and available/missing/corrupt status.

comparisons.before: No content hash or read-time byte verification.
comparisons.after: SHA-256 is computed before persistence and verified with byte size on read; failed verification blocks delivery and marks the artifact corrupt.

comparisons.before: The current report depended on live React state and did not freeze exact Run lineage.
comparisons.after: Historical reports resolve an exact ScenarioRevision plus explicit compatible Run(s); dirty drafts use an explicit live_compatibility binding rather than silently borrowing an older revision.

comparisons.before: No Run History report generation path.
comparisons.after: Run History offers Generate report for succeeded simulation Runs and renders retained compact results while identifying absent signal surfaces/ray geometry.

Public baseline, Pareto, recommendation, effective priorities, constraints, and selected solution identity are rendered from Run details without rerunning the optimizer; the private evaluation ledger is labelled unavailable.

The source resolver accepts explicit same-revision Run sets and rejects missing or incompatible project/scenario/revision sources. The current UI intentionally generates one selected historical Run at a time.

comparisons.before: Current-state PDF/print and Markdown actions only.
comparisons.after: The Report tool lists local artifacts with inspect, download, regenerate-as-new-artifact, and delete actions; Run History adds Generate report.

comparisons.before: No retained artifact state to diagnose.
comparisons.after: Missing bytes, corrupt bytes, malformed metadata, storage failure, and quota pressure have explicit states/messages; generation failure never creates a valid-looking partial artifact.

comparisons.before: There were no retained report bytes to clean up.
comparisons.after: Artifact deletion removes only its metadata/bytes; source Runs and revisions remain. Project deletion clears project artifacts through the separate store before workspace deletion.

comparisons.before: No local artifact ceiling or quota warning policy.
comparisons.after: One artifact is capped at 64 MiB, projected usage warns at 80% when browser quota APIs exist, and evidence is never silently evicted.

comparisons.before: Project export had no report artifact model.
comparisons.after: ProjectV2 export remains planning metadata; report bytes stay in atom-artifacts until a future explicit evidence-bundle format is designed.

unchanged_boundaries: RF propagation, interference, optimization, Pareto membership, recommendation, dataset semantics, and API contracts
Concept 7C Run History capture and compact retained-result policy
measurement privacy and raw input boundaries

verification.responsive_smoke: 33 passed, 3 intentionally skipped across desktop/tablet/mobile workspace projects

verification.concept_7e_recommendation: Inspect Scenario and Branch UX friction next; defer large evidence bundles or backend durable storage until cross-device or collaboration demand is demonstrated.
